item.title: My Contribution Featured in Hacker Journal N.275
How I Solved the Unlock Security OSINT Challenge
item.description: Inspired by the many challenges by Gary Ruddell (LinkedIn Profile), Unlock Security (LinkedIn Profile) has introduced a rather unique OSINT challenge: no contextual information and just a single blurry photo with few visible details. 🔎 The Challenge: Can you determine the location where this photo was taken? Step 1: Using Face Recognition To begin, I used facecheck.id, an online face recognition tool, to identify if the person in the photo appears on any public platform or social media.

item.title: My OSCP Journey - Tips, Tricks and Cheat Sheets
item.description: Welcome! I’m excited to introduce a project I’ve been working on during my preparation for the Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) certification. item.title: CVE-2020-13654
item.description: XWiki Platform < 12.8 - Stored Cross Site Scripting (XSS) CVE Detail In XWiki Platform before version 12.8, certain fields like “Company” in the user profile editing section are vulnerable to Stored Cross Site Scripting (XSS) attacks due to improper escaping. Vulnerability Summary Product CVE CVSSv3 Score CWE XWiki CVE-2020-13654 7.5 (High) CWE-116 Exploitation Steps This vulnerability allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts into certain fields (e.g., “Company”) in the user profile section, which are subsequently executed in the browser of any user accessing the page.
